name: ARMOR-RADAR
notes: The core, the node state machine, the sensor decoders and the Wi-Fi board layer are tested on a computer: 2,212 checks across nine host test programs, all passing (no frame captured from a real LD2450 is kept as a fixture yet). Its emitted payloads and device states are all accepted by ARMOR-COMMON's shared contract checker. The firmware runs on a real Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH board with a radar; the LD2461 and presence-sensor decoders, the pin assignment of the PoE board and the Wi-Fi board have not been verified on hardware.
